reviews.title: AS3 Wave 6 genuine runtime conformance promotions across Flash Player and AIR
reviews.summary: Promote 1,197 AS3 declarations genuinely implemented and verified in Rust/WASM and the HTML5 host (namespace URI isolation, fast-memory opcodes, FTE TextLine & Stage3D mipmap/cube rendering, PBJ control flow, GIF/SWF Loader, DOM ContextMenu, Multitouch/GameInput, Camera/Microphone/StageVideo, ARIA Accessibility, XML-DSig C14N/RSA, StageText); keep OS/socket/DRM/RTMP/VFS APIs partial.
